text:
```yaml
name: Release Binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            ext: ""
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            ext: ""
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Crystal
        uses: crystal-lang/install-crystal@v1
        with:
          crystal: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: shards install

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          crystal build src/noir.cr --release --no-debug --static
          mv noir noir-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}

      - name: Upload release asset
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: noir-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}
          asset_name: noir-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref }}
          overwrite: true
```
